points.description: States that selection sort moves through the array from left to right, or considers each array position/current element in turn. Equivalent wording is acceptable.
States that the minimum (smallest) value is found among the remaining/unsorted elements.

levels.says: Mentions finding the minimum/smallest element but does not make clear that it is found among the remaining/unsorted elements.

points.description: States that the minimum element is swapped with the current element, placing the minimum at the current position.

levels.says: Mentions swapping/exchanging elements but does not identify that the minimum is swapped with the current element.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a sentence that includes all three ideas: moving left to right/current position, finding the minimum among the remaining elements, and swapping that minimum with the current element. Part marks are available where the answer mentions finding a minimum or swapping but omits the key qualifier. No marks for answers that describe a different sorting method or only say 'sorting' without selection, minimum, or swap.
